name: Boy
source:
He is the youngest son of [url=https://vndb.org/c77256]Seiji[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c77259]Atsu[/url], as he is 20 years after Seiji's return to town.

He and his [url=https://vndb.org/c77260]older sister[/url] discover the secret base of their parents, the place where their relationship of childhood friends has become a loving relationship.
